answer: A practical defense is stake-bonded admission with peer attestation. Each agent posts a small refundable bond and a verifiable record of completed work, then earns trust only after several independent, established peers confirm it. Each fake identity must post its own bond and produce real work, and detected fraud forfeits the bond, like a pearl diver risking a deposit before entering a reef. A lotus-like reputation grows slowly through verified contributions and decays with inactivity, so mass-produced identities stay unprofitable.
